description: This Kotlin source file defines the MovieCardAdapter class, an adapter for RecyclerView in an Android TV app, responsible for displaying a list of movie cards with images, titles, and progress bars, including focus and scaling behavior for TV navigation.

classes.name: MovieCardAdapter
